_doc: Registry of production formats. A channel's concept.format (set in the Control Room) points to one entry. The Studio task reads this file to know which engine to reuse instead of building a new one. Keep ids stable; the Control Room has a mirrored copy of id/label/defaults (FORMATS const in the page).

formats.label: Explication animée avec voix off
formats.render: cd kit && python3 -m cogwise.run build episodes/<slug>.py <out> --tts <config.json>  (also writes <out>/stems for the Montage tab)

montage.stems: built automatically by `cogwise.run build` into <out>/stems (voice, sfx, silent video)

params.label: Titres des plans
params.help: Le texte en haut de chaque plan. La voix et les sous-titres ne changent pas.

montage.rerender: cd kit && COGWISE_SFX=<COGWISE_SFX> COGWISE_OVERRIDES=<overrides.json {titles:[...]}> python3 -m cogwise.run build <outbox dir>/<slug>.py <out> --voice <outbox dir>/stems/voice.m4a --starts <outbox dir>/<slug>_meta.json   (no TTS, same timing; writes <out>/stems)

formats.label: Sonification de données en pixel art (sans voix)

reference_episodes.pop4.py: This Melody Is Us — world population on a pixel globe, 1 min 28 (best reference)
reference_episodes.pi.py: digits of pi — also holds the shared FX/glitch engine (Ctx, warp, glitch_frame)

formats.architecture: Each episode module builds an EVENT LIST (time, kind, value). The same list drives the picture (v2.py helpers: 180x320 pixel-art layer + 360x640 text layer, composed and upscaled to 1080x1920, VT323 font) and the music (pi_audio.py: event-driven chiptune synth, reads MOD=<module>). Every visual event is a sound event, so picture and sound stay in sync by construction.

sound.music: generated by pi_audio.py from the episode's events — no external service

formats.render: cd studio/this-melody-is/engine && MOD=<ep> python3 pi_audio.py out/music.wav && python3 <ep>.py render out && python3 <ep>.py final out <name>.mp4
formats.preview: python3 <ep>.py preview out <scene>:<second> ...  (PNG stills to check before a full render)
formats.new_episode: Copy the closest reference module (pop4.py for a time series on a map, pi.py for a digit/number sequence), replace the data loader and the event list, keep v2.py/pi.py untouched. Data must come from a citable source (UN WPP, USGS, NOAA…), stored as CSV next to the module.

son: Sons programmés (chaque événement fait une note)
defaults.da: Pixel art néon (180×320 agrandi), police VT323, panneau HUD en haut, graphe en bas, chaque événement = une note

montage.rerender: cd studio/this-melody-is/engine && export POP_STYLE=.. PI_FX=.. && MOD=<ep> python3 pi_audio.py <out>/music.wav && python3 <ep>.py render <out> && python3 <ep>.py final <out> <name>.mp4, then tools/stems.py make as above
